description: Extension of the OnboardingView class providing async methods for loading, initializing, applying, and saving workspace configurations, as well as generating related commands.

methods.name: loadWorkspaceDefaults
methods.description: Loads default workspace if none is set, updating workspacePath and refreshes bootstrap status.

methods.name: ensureDefaultWorkspace
methods.description: Ensures the workspace is set up properly when in local connection mode, retrying bootstrap if necessary and updating status.

methods.name: refreshBootstrapStatus
methods.description: Updates the needsBootstrap flag based on the current workspace path and bootstrap requirements.

methods.name: workspaceBootstrapCommand
methods.description: Generates a shell command string to create a directory and populate a markdown file with a default template.

methods.name: applyWorkspace
methods.description: Attempts to bootstrap and set the workspace path, updating status messages accordingly, with concurrency control.

methods.name: loadAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the current workspace configuration from persistent storage.

methods.name: saveAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Asynchronously saves the specified workspace to configuration storage, updating status based on success or failure.

methods.name: buildAndSaveWorkspace
methods.description: Performs the actual save operation, returning success status and error message if any, on the main actor.
